title: Martin Luther King Jr. is assassinated
summary: Martin Luther King Jr. was shot dead on a balcony of the Lorraine Motel in Memphis by James Earl Ray.
reason: King was in Memphis to support striking sanitation workers.
significance: His death set off riots in more than 100 American cities.
place: Lorraine Motel, Memphis, Tennessee, United States
wikipedia: Assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.
